query:
-- Add 100 credits to the test customer
INSERT INTO userCredits (userId, totalCredits, usedCredits, remainingCredits, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, 100, 0, 100, NOW(), NOW() FROM users WHERE openId = 'test-customer-001';

-- Verify the credits were added
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, uc.totalCredits, uc.remainingCredits FROM users u
LEFT JOIN userCredits uc ON u.id = uc.userId
WHERE u.openId = 'test-customer-001';
